headline: AI-assisted workflows, built to be checked.
subtitle: Entry-level profile in AI & workflow automation. Four public projects with tests, saved results and stated limits. Moving to Latvia on 7 January 2027 — open to daily on-site work in Riga.

availability.detail: Open to daily on-site work in Riga
Spoken B2; reading and writing at C level (self-assessed, no certificate)

competencies.title: Evaluating LLM prompts with traceable results
competencies.evidence: Prompt Lab v0.4: 9 active and 4 reserved cases; human verdicts logged apart from model reviews. On 18 Nov, 10/10 automatic checks vs 8/10 baseline, with partial human review.

competencies.title: Rule-based checks with explicit pass / review / error states
competencies.evidence: Editorial checker v1.0: JSON output and exit codes 0 / 1 / 2, never an automatic approval; 12 acceptance tests reported passing.

competencies.title: Reconciling and evaluating time-ordered data without leakage
competencies.evidence: Polar, N=1 retrospective: expanding-history evaluation; 5 input variables reconciled from raw export to CSV with no discrepancies.
